difficulty_rationale: Level 3 cross-cutting. The impacted call sites (openai.chat.completions.create) span three directories and include a non-obvious one in fine_tuning/use_model.js, so directory name is not a shortcut. Nine sibling files in the SAME repository import the same `openai` package and call sibling endpoints (embeddings, images, moderations, files, batches, fine-tuning jobs, assistants, threads); a correct trace must follow the actual endpoint each call reaches, not the fact that the file imports the provider.

faults.description: Provider removed POST /v1/chat/completions and superseded it with the Responses API POST /v1/responses. Every consumer of openai.chat.completions.create must migrate.

importChain: openai package (POST /v1/chat/completions) -> openai.chat.completions.create(...) at each impacted file

notes: SEALED ANSWER KEY. Hand-derived by reading the repository source at the pinned commit with grep, NEVER from any product output. `expected_findings` are exactly the files containing a genuine `openai.chat.completions.create(...)` call. `false_positive_traps` are the sibling files that import the same `openai` package but call a DIFFERENT endpoint that the injected change does not touch. This file must never be copied into, or reachable from, the repository under test.
